ck_profiles_other_gender.name: ck_profiles_other_gender
ck_profiles_other_gender.value: ("profiles"."gender" = 'Outro' AND "profiles"."other_gender" IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim("profiles"."other_gender")) BETWEEN 1 AND 100) OR ("profiles"."gender" <> 'Outro' AND "profiles"."other_gender" IS NULL)

ck_profiles_market_interest.name: ck_profiles_market_interest
ck_profiles_market_interest.value: "profiles"."market_interest" IN ('Sim, tenho interesse.','Talvez — quero conhecer melhor.','Não tenho interesse.')

ck_events_closure_shape.name: ck_events_closure_shape
ck_events_closure_shape.value: ("events"."closure_mode" IS NULL AND "events"."closure_requested_at" IS NULL AND "events"."admin_deadline_at" IS NULL) OR ("events"."closure_mode" IN ('immediate','controlled') AND "events"."closure_requested_at" IS NOT NULL AND "events"."admin_deadline_at" IS NOT NULL)

ck_events_closure_deadline.name: ck_events_closure_deadline
ck_events_closure_deadline.value: "events"."closure_mode" IS NULL OR ("events"."closure_mode" = 'immediate' AND "events"."admin_deadline_at" = "events"."closure_requested_at") OR ("events"."closure_mode" = 'controlled' AND "events"."closure_requested_at" < "events"."admin_deadline_at" AND "events"."admin_deadline_at" <= LEAST("events"."closure_requested_at" + interval '1 hour', "events"."operational_deadline_at"))

uq_user_roles_event_active.name: uq_user_roles_event_active
uq_user_roles_event_active.where: "user_roles"."revoked_at" IS NULL AND "user_roles"."event_id" IS NOT NULL

ck_user_roles_shape.name: ck_user_roles_shape
ck_user_roles_shape.value: "user_roles"."role" IN ('participante','staff','admin') AND (("user_roles"."role" = 'staff' AND "user_roles"."event_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("user_roles"."role" IN ('participante','admin') AND "user_roles"."event_id" IS NULL))

ck_user_totp_verified.name: ck_user_totp_verified
ck_user_totp_verified.value: ("user_totp_credentials"."is_verified" = false AND "user_totp_credentials"."verified_at" IS NULL) OR ("user_totp_credentials"."is_verified" = true AND "user_totp_credentials"."verified_at" IS NOT NULL)

ck_participations_terminal.name: ck_participations_terminal
ck_participations_terminal.value: ("participations"."status" IN ('waiting','active') AND "participations"."finished_at" IS NULL AND "participations"."finish_reason" IS NULL) OR ("participations"."status" IN ('finished','canceled') AND "participations"."finished_at" IS NOT NULL AND "participations"."finish_reason" IS NOT NULL)

ck_queue_entries_closed.name: ck_queue_entries_closed
ck_queue_entries_closed.value: ("queue_entries"."status" = 'closed' AND "queue_entries"."closed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "queue_entries"."close_reason" IS NOT NULL) OR ("queue_entries"."status" IN ('waiting','called') AND "queue_entries"."closed_at" IS NULL AND "queue_entries"."close_reason" IS NULL)

ck_service_sessions_resolution.name: ck_service_sessions_resolution
ck_service_sessions_resolution.value: ("service_sessions"."status" = 'pending' AND "service_sessions"."resolved_at" IS NULL AND "service_sessions"."resolved_by_user_id" IS NULL AND "service_sessions"."cancel_reason" IS NULL) OR ("service_sessions"."status" IN ('completed','absent') AND "service_sessions"."resolved_at" IS NOT NULL AND "service_sessions"."cancel_reason" IS NULL) OR ("service_sessions"."status" = 'canceled' AND "service_sessions"."resolved_at" IS NOT NULL AND "service_sessions"."cancel_reason" IS NOT NULL)

ck_idempotency_http_status.name: ck_idempotency_http_status
ck_idempotency_http_status.value: ("idempotency_operations"."status" = 'in_progress' AND "idempotency_operations"."http_status" IS NULL) OR ("idempotency_operations"."status" = 'completed' AND "idempotency_operations"."http_status" IS NOT NULL)
